_provenance: M10 sensory<->central coupling atlas (v1.11). EVERY gamma here is CITED VERBATIM (read-only, copied digit-for-digit, NEVER re-fetched and NEVER re-derived) from the neuro v1.10.1 cached sensory atlas -- this is the single-source rule (PROJECT_BOUNDARY_neuro_mind.md / VP-SPEC C1): mind cites the measured object, neuro owns it. The eight sensory receptor/organ nodes are exactly the nodes neuro EMERGES in its sensory _atlas dictionaries: five from repro/neuro/_engine/data/sensory_organ_gamma.json (eye/PAX6, ear/PAX2, olfactory/LHX2, taste/POU2F3, skin/TP63) and three from repro/neuro/_engine/data/full_sensory_gamma.json (nociceptor/PRDM12, proprioceptor/RUNX3, vestibular/ATOH1). They cover the canonical NINE human sensory modalities: the skin organ (TP63) hosts the low-threshold somatosensory submodalities touch (PIEZO2) and warmth (thermoreceptor, neutral 32C), pain is the high-threshold nociceptor (PRDM12), and the special senses are vision, hearing, smell, taste, and balance -- exactly neuro v1.10.1 sec 20's 'one organ, three submodalities' inventory. corr(gamma,GC) over these masters is the same lawful read-out neuro reports (organ atlas 0.994, the four sec 20 modalities 0.997). The gamma layer is Layer-1 [F]. f0_hz is the modality's empirically-dominant input/processing band: its BAND IDENTITY is cited to the experimental literature, but the absolute centre frequency in Hz is Layer-2 [O] (a representative value, NOT read from the gamma window and NOT tuned to any model target; guarded by the +/-20% band-perturbation robustness check). The central relay is the modality's first anatomical central target; the afferent couples to it at the SAME measured ephaptic threshold fraction kappa=0.5496 (neuro 19) -- no new tuned constant is introduced.
_metric: gamma = mean(-NN dG37), SantaLucia 1998 (read-only; identical to DNA/neuro/M0/M9). NOT recomputed here -- copied verbatim from the neuro files above.
_grading: gamma [F measured input, cited verbatim from neuro]; band identity [cited]; absolute f0 in Hz [O representative]; central relay [anatomical, cited]; afferent coupling kappa is the SAME MEASURED ephaptic fraction (neuro 19), NOT per-edge tuned; ring geometry [O]. medium_efficacy_tested stays 0 -- whether cognition USES sensory<->central coupling is OPEN.
_relay_rationale: Each sensory afferent projects to its first central relay among the twelve M9 central organs: the special exteroceptive senses (vision/LGN, hearing/MGN, touch+warmth/VPL, pain/spinothalamic-VPL) enter through the thalamus (the sensory gateway); taste (NTS) and balance (vestibular nuclei) enter through the brainstem; smell bypasses the thalamus and enters the olfactory bulb directly; proprioception (muscle spindle) projects to the cerebellum. The afferent is reciprocal (thalamo-/relay-cortical style) at the measured kappa -- the same threshold fraction used everywhere, never re-tuned.
